prompt:
A remote-controlled boat moves at constant speed 4.0 m s^-1 along a semicircular path of radius 14 m from P to Q. It then remains stationary at Q for 5.0 s.
[FIGURE PLACEHOLDER: Semicircular path of radius 14 m from point P to point Q on a horizontal water surface, with straight diameter PQ = 28 m.]
(a) State the distance travelled and the magnitude of the displacement when the boat first reaches Q. [2]
(b) Calculate the time taken to move from P to Q. [2]
(c) Calculate the average speed from leaving P until the end of the stationary period. [1]
(d) Calculate the magnitude of the average velocity over the same complete time interval and explain why it is smaller than the average speed. [2]

parts.label: (a)
parts.prompt: State the distance travelled and the magnitude of the displacement when the boat first reaches Q.

parts.label: (b)
parts.prompt: Calculate the time taken to move from P to Q.

parts.label: (c)
parts.prompt: Calculate the average speed from leaving P until the end of the stationary period.

parts.label: (d)
parts.prompt: Calculate the magnitude of the average velocity over the same complete time interval and explain why it is smaller than the average speed.

part_enrichment.guidance: Distance follows the semicircular perimeter (pi * r). Displacement is the straight distance across the diameter (2r).
Use path distance (44.0 m), not displacement, because speed applies to actual distance travelled.
part_enrichment.common_pitfall: Dividing displacement (28 m) by 4.0 m s^-1.

part_enrichment.guidance: Include the stationary 5.0 s in the total time: total time = 11.0 + 5.0 = 16.0 s.

marking_points.criterion: Calculates average velocity = displacement / total time = 28 / 16.0 = 1.75 m s^-1.
Explains that straight-line displacement (28 m) is less than curved path distance (44.0 m) while total time (16.0 s) is identical.

part_enrichment.guidance: Average velocity uses resultant displacement 28 m over total time 16.0 s. Explain comparison clearly.
part_enrichment.common_pitfall: Stating that time was different or failing to explicitly compare numerators.

hints: For part (a), perimeter of semicircle is pi * r. Displacement is the straight line connecting P and Q (the diameter 2r).
For part (b), the boat travels along the perimeter at 4.0 m s^-1. Time = distance / speed.
For part (c), total time includes the 5.0 s wait: total time = t_motion + 5.0 s.
For part (d), average velocity uses displacement divided by total time. Compare with average speed.
solution:
(a) Distance = 14 * pi = 44.0 m. Displacement = 2 * 14 = 28 m.
(b) Time = 43.98 / 4.0 = 11.0 s.
(c) Total time = 11.0 + 5.0 = 16.0 s. Average speed = 43.98 / 16.0 = 2.75 m s^-1.
(d) Average velocity magnitude = 28 / 16.0 = 1.75 m s^-1. It is smaller than average speed because displacement (28 m) is less than distance travelled (44.0 m) for the same total time.
teacher_walkthrough: In part (a), distinguish path distance along the curved boundary (14pi m = 44.0 m) from straight displacement across the diameter (28 m).
In part (b), ensure students use distance, not displacement, to find time along the curve: 44.0 / 4.0 = 11.0 s.
In part (c), emphasize that average speed encompasses the entire duration, including stationary waiting time: 11.0 + 5.0 = 16.0 s.
In part (d), calculate average velocity as 28 m / 16.0 s = 1.75 m s^-1 and highlight that displacement is always <= distance.
